title: 水庫排砂隧道~Reservoir sediment-bypass tunnels
focus: 以分流輸砂磨耗與下游銜接驗證排砂隧道~Verifying sediment bypass through diversion transport abrasion and downstream connection
summary: 本課以以分流輸砂磨耗與下游銜接驗證排砂隧道為主線，先用分流比與庫區水量與懸砂質量通量界定水力與構造條件，再將沉降與行程時間、底板磨耗與厚度連結到水砂守恆與稽核。聚焦繞庫排砂而非任意沖刷壩基，輸砂與磨耗算例為分段簡化且需現地級配驗證。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops verifying sediment bypass through diversion transport abrasion and downstream connection through Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow and Suspended sediment mass flux, then connects Settling and transit time and Invert abrasion and thickness to Water sediment conservation audit. The focus is sediment bypass rather than arbitrary foundation flushing; simplified transport and abrasion examples need field gradation validation. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 本課所研究的以分流輸砂磨耗與下游銜接驗證排砂隧道，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。聚焦繞庫排砂而非任意沖刷壩基，輸砂與磨耗算例為分段簡化且需現地級配驗證。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。~The focus on verifying sediment bypass through diversion transport abrasion and downstream connection reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. The focus is sediment bypass rather than arbitrary foundation flushing; simplified transport and abrasion examples need field gradation validation. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查分流比與庫區水量：incomingQ=100 m3/s; bypassQ=40 m3/s; waterDiversionFraction=40/100=0.40；再獨立檢查懸砂質量通量：bypassQ=40 m3/s; representativeSSC=3 kg/m3; suspendedFlux=40*3=120 kg/s。敏感度：固定水量40m3/s時含砂質量濃度由3增至5kg/m3，輸砂率由120增至200kg/s，增加66.7%；並不表示相同百分比的河床載砂或磨耗，粗顆粒接觸需另分析。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。聚焦繞庫排砂而非任意沖刷壩基，輸砂與磨耗算例為分段簡化且需現地級配驗證。 將沿下游多斷面採樣並比較橫向混合與沉降變化作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow: incomingQ=100 m3/s; bypassQ=40 m3/s; waterDiversionFraction=40/100=0.40. Independently examine Suspended sediment mass flux: bypassQ=40 m3/s; representativeSSC=3 kg/m3; suspendedFlux=40*3=120 kg/s. Sensitivity: at40m3/s, increasing mass concentration from3 to5kg/m3 raises suspended flux from120 to200kg/s, or66.7 percent. Bed load and abrasion do not necessarily increase by the same percentage because coarse-grain contact requires separate analysis. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. The focus is sediment bypass rather than arbitrary foundation flushing; simplified transport and abrasion examples need field gradation validation. Use the following independent check: Sample several downstream sections and compare lateral mixing and settling. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 分流比與庫區水量~Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow
units.title: 分流比與庫區水量~Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow
units.mechanism: 繞庫隧道在上游分流含砂洪水，將部分水砂送至壩下而減少進庫沉積。水量分流比不等於泥砂分流比，因垂向與橫向濃度可能不均；應同時量測分流前後水量、懸砂與粗粒，避免只以閘門開度推估成效。 驗證時應同步量測主河與分流口水砂並核對庫區剩餘入流，並辨識以下失效情境：只看水量分流可能高估實際砂量攔截。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A bypass diverts sediment-laden inflow upstream of the reservoir and reconnects downstream. Water diversion fraction is not sediment diversion fraction because concentration varies vertically and laterally. Measure water, suspended sediment and coarse material on both branches rather than inferring performance solely from gate position. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure water and sediment simultaneously in both branches and reconcile residual reservoir inflow. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Water diversion alone can overstate sediment interception. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：incomingQ=100 m3/s; bypassQ=40 m3/s; waterDiversionFraction=40/100=0.40。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: incomingQ=100 m3/s; bypassQ=40 m3/s; waterDiversionFraction=40/100=0.40. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Water diversion alone can overstate sediment interception. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.
units.failure: 只看水量分流可能高估實際砂量攔截。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步量測主河與分流口水砂並核對庫區剩餘入流，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。~Water diversion alone can overstate sediment interception. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure water and sediment simultaneously in both branches and reconcile residual reservoir inflow. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

units.practice: 交接時以同步量測主河與分流口水砂並核對庫區剩餘入流作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只看水量分流可能高估實際砂量攔截，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。~At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure water and sediment simultaneously in both branches and reconcile residual reservoir inflow. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Water diversion alone can overstate sediment interception. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 懸砂質量通量~Suspended sediment mass flux
units.title: 懸砂質量通量~Suspended sediment mass flux
units.mechanism: 懸浮泥砂通量由水量與代表性質量濃度相乘，採樣點是否代表整個斷面是關鍵。濁度需現地率定，粗顆粒可能以掃流通過而不在水樣中；質量帳應明確區分懸砂與床載，不能把單一表層水樣當全部輸砂。 驗證時應以斷面積分採樣比對濁度率定並另記粗粒輸送，並辨識以下失效情境：表層低濃度水樣會漏估近床高濃度泥砂。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Suspended flux equals discharge times representative mass concentration. Sampling must represent the section and turbidity needs local calibration. Coarse bed load may pass outside the water samples, so distinguish suspended and bed-load budgets instead of treating a single surface sample as total transport. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check turbidity against cross-section sampling and document coarse transport separately. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A dilute surface sample underestimates concentrated near-bed sediment. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：bypassQ=40 m3/s; representativeSSC=3 kg/m3; suspendedFlux=40*3=120 kg/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: bypassQ=40 m3/s; representativeSSC=3 kg/m3; suspendedFlux=40*3=120 kg/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 事件輸砂與效率~Event mass and bypass efficiency
units.title: 事件輸砂與效率~Event mass and bypass efficiency
units.mechanism: 繞庫成效應按洪水事件積分輸砂質量，再與同事件進砂相比。只取峰值濃度乘總水量可能偏差很大，因濃度峰與流量峰未必同步；事件前後暫存砂量也應列入，才能區分真正繞庫與短期堆積。 驗證時應以同時間窗積分各支流水砂通量並調查分流前池淤積，並辨識以下失效情境：漏算分流前池暫存會把滯留砂誤當成功繞庫。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Evaluate bypass efficiency from event-integrated sediment mass relative to the same incoming event. Peak concentration times total water can be biased because peaks need not coincide. Include temporary storage changes to distinguish successful bypass from sediment merely retained near the intake. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Integrate branch fluxes over one window and survey intake-pool storage. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring intake-pool storage misclassifies retained sediment as successful bypass. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：eventIncomingSediment=30000 t; measuredBypassedSediment=21000 t; eventEfficiency=21000/30000*100=70 percent。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: eventIncomingSediment=30000 t; measuredBypassedSediment=21000 t; eventEfficiency=21000/30000*100=70 percent. units.anchor: 隧道自由水面輸送~Free-surface tunnel conveyance
units.title: 隧道自由水面輸送~Free-surface tunnel conveyance
units.mechanism: 排砂隧道常需高速輸送以減少沉積，但自由水面與滿流邊界必須明確區分。平均速度由有效水深與寬度求得，不能用整個開挖截面代替通水面積；沿程含氣、彎道與頂部餘裕也會影響輸送穩定。 驗證時應核對沿程水深速度與含氣厚度並確認未碰頂滿流，並辨識以下失效情境：誤用開挖面積會低估流速與局部磨耗作用。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~High-speed conveyance can reduce deposition, but free-surface and pressurized boundaries must be distinguished. Calculate mean velocity from actual wetted area rather than the excavated section. Aeration, bends and clearance above the flow also affect stable sediment transport and require separate checks. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check depth, velocity and aerated thickness along the tunnel and confirm free-surface clearance. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using excavation area understates velocity and local abrasion exposure. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Rectangular wetted width=4 m; depth=1.25 m; Q=40 m3/s; velocity=40/(4*1.25)=8 m/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Rectangular wetted width=4 m; depth=1.25 m; Q=40 m3/s; velocity=40/(4*1.25)=8 m/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 沉降與行程時間~Settling and transit time
units.title: 沉降與行程時間~Settling and transit time
units.mechanism: 泥砂能否在輸送中沉降取決於沉速與停留時間，同時受紊流懸浮與床面再啟動影響。靜水沉降距離只示範兩種時間尺度，不能預測高速隧道的實際沉積；仍需粒徑分級及近床濃度觀測。 驗證時應比較各粒徑沉速與流行時間並量測近床濃度，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略紊流再懸浮會把靜水沉降距離誤當實際淤厚。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Deposition depends on settling speed and residence time together with turbulent suspension and reentrainment. A still-water settling distance compares time scales but does not predict deposition in a turbulent bypass tunnel. Size fractions and near-bed observations remain necessary to establish transport behavior. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare size-specific settling speeds with transit time and measure near-bed concentration. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring turbulent suspension turns settling distance into a false deposition thickness. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：L=1200 m; meanV=8 m/s; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.01 m/s; settlingDistance=0.01*(1200/8)=1.50 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: L=1200 m; meanV=8 m/s; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.01 m/s; settlingDistance=0.01*(1200/8)=1.50 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 床面剪力與啟動~Bed shear and entrainment
units.title: 床面剪力與啟動~Bed shear and entrainment
units.mechanism: 床面剪力與顆粒水下重量的比值可作啟動條件尺度，但粗糙、遮蔽、坡度與級配會改變臨界值。示意希爾茲數不能直接指定一個普遍啟動門檻；應以現地粒料與適用實驗比較，並分辨掃流與懸浮。 驗證時應核對床面剪力估法與粒徑級配並觀察顆粒啟動，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略粗粒遮蔽可能高估細粒實際輸移能力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A Shields parameter compares bed shear with submerged particle weight. Roughness, hiding, slope and gradation alter the critical value, so an illustrative number does not establish a universal entrainment threshold. Compare representative sediment with suitable experiments and distinguish bed load from suspension. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check the shear estimate and gradation and observe particle entrainment. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring hiding by coarse particles can overestimate transport of sheltered fines. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 底板磨耗與厚度~Invert abrasion and thickness
units.title: 底板磨耗與厚度~Invert abrasion and thickness
units.mechanism: 粗粒高速接觸底板會產生磨耗，其分布與流束集中、彎道及施工接縫有關。兩次測量差除以期間只給過去平均耗損率，不能自動預報未來壽命；材料改變、事件強度與裸露鋼筋都可能使速率改變。 驗證時應用固定基準重測磨耗圖並按流量與粒徑分組運轉時數，並辨識以下失效情境：用低含砂年度平均率外推高含砂洪水會低估損傷。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~High-speed coarse particles abrade the invert, especially where jets, bends or joints concentrate contact. Survey difference divided by elapsed exposure gives a past average, not a future life prediction. Material changes, event intensity and reinforcement exposure can alter the rate after the observation period. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Repeat abrasion surveys on a fixed datum and group exposure by discharge and grain size. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Extrapolating a low-sediment average into a coarse flood understates damage. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 出口混合與濃度~Outlet mixing and concentration
units.title: 出口混合與濃度~Outlet mixing and concentration
units.mechanism: 繞庫出口把含砂水重新接入河道，混合濃度需按水量加權而非兩濃度平均。完全混合假設通常只在足夠距離後合理，近岸高濃度帶與沉降可能主導局部影響；需量測橫斷面與事件持續時間。 驗證時應沿下游多斷面採樣並比較橫向混合與沉降變化，並辨識以下失效情境：立即套完全混合會低估出口附近局部濃度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~The outlet reconnects sediment-laden water to the river. Mixed concentration requires discharge weighting, not a simple concentration average. Complete mixing may occur only farther downstream, while near-bank plumes and settling govern local exposure; measure cross-sections and event duration instead of assuming immediate uniformity. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Sample several downstream sections and compare lateral mixing and settling. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Immediate complete-mixing assumptions understate concentration near the outlet. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 分流時機與濃度峰~Diversion timing and sediment peaks
units.title: 分流時機與濃度峰~Diversion timing and sediment peaks
units.mechanism: 洪水的含砂峰可能早於或晚於水量峰，分流時機決定可攔截的砂量與所用水量。用分段質量積分比較時窗能示範取捨，但不構成即時操作指令；實際調度還需洪水安全、下游限制與設備狀態共同核准。 驗證時應對齊水量與濃度時序並量化提前或延後時窗的差異，並辨識以下失效情境：以洪峰時間取代含砂峰會錯失高濃度時段。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Sediment peaks can precede or follow discharge peaks, making diversion timing important. Piecewise mass integration compares windows and water use but is not a real-time operating instruction. Actual decisions combine flood safety, downstream constraints and equipment state through the approved operating framework. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Align discharge and concentration histories and compare earlier and later windows. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using the water peak as the sediment peak can miss concentrated inflow. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 水砂守恆與稽核~Water sediment conservation audit
units.title: 水砂守恆與稽核~Water sediment conservation audit
units.mechanism: 完整排砂評估應讓進砂、出砂與庫內暫存閉合，並將量測不確定度與未量床載分開列出。殘差不是自動等於未量侵蝕，採樣偏差與測深基準也可能造成差額；需要以獨立地形與質量觀測交叉核算。 驗證時應用獨立測深與乾密度估算庫存變化再比對通量帳，並辨識以下失效情境：把所有殘差都歸於侵蝕會掩蓋採樣或密度錯誤。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A complete assessment reconciles incoming, outgoing and stored sediment while separating uncertainty and unmeasured bed load. A residual is not automatically erosion; sampling bias and survey datums can also create imbalance. Cross-check mass records against independent bed surveys and consistent dry-density assumptions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Estimate storage change from independent bathymetry and dry density and compare flux records. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Assigning every residual to erosion conceals sampling or density errors. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

place.name: 美國墾務局丹佛技術服務中心參照點~Reclamation Denver Technical Service Center reference
place.query: Bureau of Reclamation Technical Service Center Denver Federal Center

sources.title: 美國墾務局水工手冊與專論目錄
sources.scope: 官方目錄核實 1978 消能工專論、1980 水力試驗技術、1987 小壩設計及1990氣蝕專論；目錄日期不是工程啟用年。
sources.scopeEn: Official catalog verifies the 1978 dissipator monograph, 1980 laboratory techniques, 1987 small-dam manual and 1990 cavitation monograph; publication dates are not project commissioning dates.

sources.title: 蘇黎世聯邦理工水工模型研究目錄
sources.titleEn: ETH Zurich hydraulic model research catalog
sources.scope: 已讀原始研究目錄，核實Solis繞庫排砂模型及Palagnedra磨耗研究脈絡；算例不是其量測值。
sources.scopeEn: Read the original research catalog confirming Solis bypass modeling and Palagnedra abrasion context; examples are not their measurements.

sources.title: 日本土木研究所水工與輸砂實驗室
sources.titleEn: PWRI hydraulics and sediment transport laboratory
sources.scope: 官方研究頁說明洪水繞庫排砂、含砂水與縮尺試驗限制；不把實驗比例當本課設計值。
sources.scopeEn: Official laboratory page describes flood sediment bypass, turbid flow and physical-model limits; laboratory scales are not course design inputs.

sources.title: 日本國土交通省美和壩繞庫排砂
sources.publisher: Ministry of Land Infrastructure Transport and Tourism
sources.scope: 官方原始頁核實美和繞庫隧道與試驗運轉歷程；僅用作排砂途徑比較，無工程參數移植。
sources.scopeEn: Official page verifies Miwa bypass and its trial-operation history; used for pathway comparison without transplanting parameters.
